title: Going and coming: megy and jön

sections.title: Two verbs, every person
sections.content: You met *megyek*, *mész* and *megy* as ready-made chunks, and *jön* (comes) too. Both are irregular, so the stem changes with the person. Here is the whole present of each. The plural forms are the ones to learn: *megyünk*, *mentek*, *mennek* and *jövünk*, *jöttök*, *jönnek*.

sections.title: Where and how
sections.content: Use the verbs with what you already know: the place takes *-ba/-be* (*Hová?*), and the vehicle or company takes *-val/-vel* (*Mivel? Kivel?*). *Mivel* is *mi* + *-vel* (by what?), and *Kivel* is *ki* + *-vel* (with whom?).

items.english: I am going to the museum.
Are you going to the bank?

sections.content: Learn the stems as they are: *mész*, not *megyesz*, and *jössz*, not *jönsz*. Every person has its own form, so *Anna megy* and *Anna és Károly mennek* are different.
